findings.description: The `strncpy` function is used to copy the `id` into the `_id` array. However, if the `id` provided is longer than 2 characters (excluding the null terminator), it will not be null-terminated properly, leading to a buffer overflow.
The code does not validate the length of the `id` before copying it into the `_id` array. This can lead to undefined behavior if the input is not as expected.
